metadata.description: A company's PaddockPath records in their own Claude, read-only.

plugins.name: paddockpath-feedlot
plugins.description: Your feedlot's PaddockPath records in your own Claude, read-only, with a skill for each report feedlots make again and again. The figures follow the PaddockPath app's own definitions, and the reports come out in PaddockPath's look, Word and PDF included.
